name: message-thread-01
title: Message Thread 01 - A Conversation That Arrives
description: The message thread of a conversation, receiving messages as they arrive over a subscription the consumer supplies. The live Kind's second family: a message list with ordered parts, where the run log is a list of occurrences. Prism owns the thread, the message and part vocabulary, the status tiers and the tool-call row; the consumer owns the socket, the transport, the persistence and the durable resumption buffer. Every string is passed in as a prop.
